Container.Name: brainnet-viewer-lan
Container.Overview: BrainNet Viewer displays brain surfaces, networks, volumetric maps and atlas regions in a browser. Install this template and open WebUI over HTTP; no certificate or password is required by default. Each browser session has a separate process and workspace. Use this mode on a trusted LAN. HTTPS and password access are optional advanced settings. Save Scene downloads a portable ZIP; Export Figure downloads the image and JSON separately. CPU rendering is available without a GPU; NVIDIA acceleration is optional.
Container.Requires: Default HTTP access is unencrypted and has no password. Use only on a trusted LAN. HTTPS and password access can be enabled independently in advanced settings. Native Unraid hardware validation is pending; Docker checks are documented separately.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: brain neuroscience neuroimaging connectome MRI visualization LAN

Config.Name: Web port
Config.Description: Host HTTP port; container port stays 1031.

Config.Name: HTTP or HTTPS
Config.Description: Default http needs no certificate. For https, configure the origin and mount server.crt/server.key.

Config.Name: Password access
Config.Description: Default off opens directly. For on, mount access_password.txt (16-256 UTF-8 bytes).

Config.Name: Public origin (optional)
Config.Description: Leave empty for automatic private-IP HTTP access. Required for HTTPS or a DNS name: http(s)://host:port without a path.

Config.Name: Private server files (optional)
Config.Description: Leave empty for default HTTP/no-password mode. Optional read-only directory: server.crt/server.key for HTTPS; access_password.txt for password access. Files must be readable by UID 10001.

Config.Name: Rendering backend
Config.Description: auto uses an accessible GPU after a rendering probe, otherwise CPU. Device allocation is configured separately.

Config.Name: Maximum sessions
Config.Description: Maximum browser sessions (1-32); all share container CPU and memory limits.

Config.Name: Idle timeout (seconds)
Config.Description: Idle lifetime (30-86400 seconds). Save Scene before the session ends.

Config.Name: Worker threads
Config.Description: Scientific-library threads per worker (1-64), not a CPU quota.
